sn35.81:1.1: Then a number of bhikkhus approached the Blessed One … and said to him:
sn35.81:1.2: “Here, venerable sir, wanderers of other sects ask us:
sn35.81:1.3: ‘For what purpose, friends, is the holy life lived under the ascetic Gotama?’
sn35.81:1.4: When we are asked thus, venerable sir, we answer those wanderers thus:
sn35.81:1.5: ‘It is, friends, for the full understanding of suffering that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn35.81:1.6: We hope, venerable sir, that when we answer thus we state what has been said by the Blessed One and do not misrepresent him with what is contrary to fact; that we explain in accordance with the Dhamma, and that no reasonable consequence of our assertion gives ground for criticism.”
sn35.81:2.1: “For sure, bhikkhus, when you answer thus you state what has been said by me and do not misrepresent me with what is contrary to fact; you explain in accordance with the Dhamma, and no reasonable consequence of your assertion gives ground for criticism.
sn35.81:2.2: For, bhikkhus, it is for the full understanding of suffering that the holy life is lived under me.
sn35.81:2.3: “But, bhikkhus, if wanderers of other sects ask you:
sn35.81:2.4: ‘What, friends, is that suffering for the full understanding of which the holy life is lived under the ascetic Gotama?’—
sn35.81:2.5: being asked thus, you should answer them thus:
sn35.81:2.6: ‘The eye, friends, is suffering: it is for the full understanding of this that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.81:2.8: Whatever feeling arises with eye-contact as condition … that too is suffering …
sn35.81:2.11: Whatever feeling arises with mind-contact as condition … that too is suffering:
sn35.81:2.12: it is for the full understanding of this that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.
sn35.81:2.13: This, friends, is that suffering for the full understanding of which the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn35.81:2.14: “Being asked thus, bhikkhus, you should answer those wanderers of other sects in such a way.”
